versions.changelog: Failed tool calls are isError MCP frames (all transports); content unchanged.
Audit rows name the resolved target when a one-target call omits it.
Roles for network callers (HLD §18): built-in reader/admin and custom roles per token, checked on every call; opt in with vmware-audit roles enable.
Security fix: tools may not read or write the server's own control files; over a network transport host files only inside VMWARE_MCP_FILE_ROOT (HLD §18 step 0).
Unauthenticated /healthz for load balancers, audit correlation id (traceparent / X-Request-ID), role-less vSphere login detection (AIops#47).
Session pools per target for concurrent MCP calls (HLD §16 D-13(2)) and vSphere access self-diagnosis helper (§17 D-17).
MCP over HTTPS: bearer tokens, caller identity in audit, per-target concurrency
Tool exposure: offer only read tools plus chosen write tools (vmware_policy.exposure)
limit below 1 refused before any tool runs (MCP tool error / CLI usage error, audited); rename table adds vks issue_*_kubeconfig and pilot create_workflow_from_template
Deny rules match across the 2.0 rename in both directions
2.0 rename table: vmware-debug case_timeline -> record_case_timeline
Audit records the entry point (surface); deny rules written with pre-2.0 tool names keep working
Audit redaction runs in linear time on long free text; confirm=False previews are audited as dry_run and file no undo token.
A failed call is never audited ok: interrupted status, typer>=0.26 exits, result credential scrubbing, lost audit rows visible and self-healing, runaway guard on real arguments.
@audited for CLI reads and data egress, @cli_local for local commands; environment-label warning only when rules scope by environment
A completed dry run is audited as dry_run, not ok; dry runs record no undo token.
Credentials no longer reach the audit database by any of four paths; CLI writes made with policy disabled are marked ok_bypassed; guarded CLI commands judge the --config file they actually use.
compat: version floors that distinguish below-floor, at-floor and unreadable; fsperms.assert_owner_only for platform-honest permission assertions

Six credential shapes that still leaked (auth=(...) tuples, curl -u/--user, sshpass -p, netrc, and @ in either half of a URL userinfo), plus two status phrases that redaction had reversed: 'password: not set' had become 'password: *** set'.

Per-skill environment resolvers (an import of a sibling server was measured taking a production deny rule from DENY to ALLOW); additionalProperties:false now enforced at call time, not just declared; new fsperms with a three-state secret-file check that does not report 'cannot tell' as 'exposed'; all text reads name their encoding.
The policy engine no longer fails open when rules.yaml cannot be read; secret redaction went from 41.7% to 100% of measured leak shapes.
Audit rows no longer store credential-bearing return values; parameter descriptions now reach the MCP JSON schema.
PyPI packaging metadata: Homepage/Repository/Issues/Changelog links, README-CN mcp-name marker, plugin manifest. No behaviour change.
Moved to vmware-skills GitHub org; MCP Registry namespace → io.github.vmware-skills. Links updated.
Add the guarded CLI decorator (CLI counterpart to @vmware_tool): CLI writes route through the shared guard()+audit_call() core.
Remove read-only switch and approval tiers; read/write authz delegated to RBAC. New guard()/audit_call() core.
A policy denial raised inside a tool body no longer audits the orchestrating call as a success.
Returned error payloads are now audited as failures: correct audit status, no undo token for a change that never happened, and the circuit breaker finally sees them.
Per-target username can now come from an env var, resolved per access like the password; documented credential variables corrected against what each repo's code actually reads
MCP server moved into the package namespace (fixes silent overwrite when two skills share an environment); family_smoke 85 -> 89 checks
read_only_status() so doctors report the same answer the gate enforces; the gate is now documented in this package's own SKILL.md, setup-guide and capabilities
Read-only gate for the whole family (apply_read_only_gate), list-result envelope, declared environments; policy baseline now actually loads on a fresh install
v1.6.1 family version alignment
backlog: stop advertising an unimplemented feature
shared-decorator correctness (affects the whole family)
Security hardening: safe error handling, TLS/path/permission fixes
